built_from: live-04-not-covered-wrong-entries, his key as corrected by the coordinator on 2026-11-07: the page says the site has not researched or covered something the site covers (the exchange fee, explained with its houses on the securities account guide)
reason: A site that contradicts itself about what it knows loses the reader's trust in both pages: a reader cannot tell which place is right, and one who does not notice believes the page they are on.
for: every session (behaviour), still screens and browser alike

own_case.run: runs/live-04b (without, v1, 3 personas x 3) and runs/live-04b/contradiction-own (with, 3 personas x 1); both see the ten not-covered screens and the two screens of the securities account guide
own_case.note: built from this case, so not evidence that it generalises. Without it, every session that named the exchange fee believed the not-covered page, though it had the guide's fee table and term row in front of it.

same_reason_held_out.run: runs/live-04b/contradiction-held (with: run-reviewer.json's s14 and s19, first-job-phone and careful-retiree-pc, repeat 2); without: runs/baseline-1/reviewer and runs/baseline-2/reviewer

result.verdict: not kept: it adds nothing on the held-out cases of the same reason (the within-page contradiction is still missed by every session; the stale-date one was already caught about as often), so the own-case gain looks like memorising its own form (two pages, one saying it lacks what the other gives).
not_done: the planted p09 instances (two figures for the same thing that disagree), on their score pages
a negative check on a screen free of contradictions
a planted instance of the cross-page form: a page that says the site lacks something a second screen of the same session shows it has
